question: Mu somo ly'Essomabiramu, omusomesa ateekawo ekigendererwa kino eri Ekibiina ekisooka: "Okunnyonnyola ekitera okubaawo ku miti gy'ebibala mu biseera by'omwaka eby'enjawulo." Ku bikolwa bino wammanga, kiki ekisinga okuba ekituufu okukebera obumanyirivu bw'abayizi?
answer_a: Bawe olupapula olwereere era abayizi obagambe okukuba omuti gw'ekibala ky'asinga okwagala mu biseera by'omwaka bibiri.
answer_b: Laga ebifaananyi by'emiti egy'enjawulo era obuuze abayizi okugyawulamu egyo egibala n'egitabala.
answer_c: Waayo olupapula oluliko ebifaananyi by'emiti gy'ebibala, nga buli gumu guliko ekiseera kye gubaliramu, era obasabe okugisiiga langi.
answer_d: Waayo kaadi eziriko emiti egy'enjawulo n'endala eziriko ebibala era obuuze abayizi okukwataganya omuti n'ekibala ekiguliko.

question: Omusomesa wa pulayimale yalagidde abayizzi be ab'ekibiina eky'okusattu okusoma nga bwebaddamu olugero olumpi olulagibbwa ku lutimbe. answer_a: Okukuguka mu byensoma
answer_b: Okuzzamu ammanyi okusoma okw'okutegera
answer_c: Okwekeneenya enjatula y'ebigambo
answer_d: Okummanya okusoma okw'obubonero

question: Omusomesa anyonyola abaana enkukakyuka amazzi gye gayitamu.Mbeera ki wammanga eyinza okukozesebwa nga ekyokulabirako nti omukka gufuuka amazzi?
answer_a: Omuzira okugwa ku mazzi go mugga

answer_c: Amazzi gomugga okunyogoga negafuuka bbalaafu

answer_a: Omuyaga
answer_b: Amaanyi agasikira ebintu ku Mwezi
answer_c: Enjawulo mu bwoki bw’omu bbanga
answer_d: Enkyukakyuka mu bwoki bw'amazzi g'ennyanja

question: Soma embeera eno: Mu kibiina ky'abaana abato, Ignacio ayanjula ku ky'ekyennyanja ekya clownfish eraannyonnyola bagenzi be nti ekika kino kifuna obukuumi okuva ku ttooki y'ennyanja okulwanyisa abalya ebyennyanja ebirala, ate era n'ettooki y'ennyanja ekuumibwa kubanga ekyennyanja kigoba ebyennyanja ebirala ebigirya. Omusomesa ayingirawo okubannyonnyola erinnya ly'ekika ky'enkolagana y'ebiramu ekyogeddwaako omwana. Nkola ki ey'enkolagana y'ebiramu omusomesa gy'asaanidde okwogerako mu kunnyonnyola kwe?
answer_a: Obuwangwa obw’okubeera awamu nga ekimu ku biramu kiganyulwa ate ekirala tekirina kye kifuna wadde okufiirwa.
answer_b: Amensalism kitegeeza omukwano wakati w'ebiriwo ebimu gye kiremesa ekirala so nga kyo tekirina kye kifiirwa.
answer_c: Obutalina ludda lwe bayimiriddeko
answer_d: Omukwano ogw'obuyambi obwa buli omu

question: Omusomesa akoze emirimu gino wammanga ku kitundu eky’okuyiga ekikwata ku ndabika y’akaziba: 1. Abayizi basoma era neekebejja ebiwandiiko ebikwata ku ndabika y’akaziba ey’omulembe n’ebipimo byayo ebikulu. 2. Abayizi bakola ku bizibu ebikwata ku ndabika y’akaziba n’ebintu ebigirimu, n’enteekateeka y’amasannyalaze, n’ennamba za kwantaamu. 3. Abayizi bakubaganya ebirowoozo mu bibinja ku biwandiiko ebikwata ku nkyukakyuka mu ndabika y’akaziba n’ebipimo byayo ebikulu nga balina ebifaananyi ebigyoleka (Democritus, Dalton, Thomson, Rutherford, Bohr). 4. Abayizi bakola okugeraageranya ku ndabika z’akaziba ez’enjawulo nga booleka ebipimo byazo ebikulu. Mu nteekateeka zino wammanga, engeri ki esinga okukubiriza okuyiga okutondekawo okutegeera okw’amaanyi ku ndabika y’akaziba?

Mu kwekkeneenya mu bufunze, omusomesa w'ebiramu ayogera ekibuuzo kino wammanga: Nkyukakyuka kimu mubiri eziyinza okuzuula mu mukazi eyaweebwa eddagala okuyimiriza ekikolwa kya GnHR? Zinnyonyole. Kwekkeneenya ki wammanga okugoberera ebiraga okukolebwa ekintu ekitegekeddwa?
answer_a: Omulimu gw'obuwangwa oguleeta enkyukakyuka mu buvubuka.
answer_b: Nnyonnyola engeri omutwe gw’obwongo gye gufugaamu omusinde gw’eb激素 eziva mu kitundu kya hypothalamus ku musinde gw’ebisa eggi n’omubiri gw’ennyingo.
answer_c: Nnyonnyola omulandira gw’ebintu ebiddiring’ana mu mutendera gw’ekizadde ng’okozesa omutendera gw’obuwulukuto, okuva kw’eggimu, n’omutendera gwa luteal.
answer_d: Nnyonnyola omulandira gw’ebintu ebiddiring’ana mu mutendera gw’omubiri gw’ekyenda nga bikwatagana n’okukyenga omusaayi, ekiseera eky’okukula, n’ekiseera eky’okukola ebintu.

question: Mu kitundu "Amaanyi G'amasannyalaze n'Emigugu gy'amasannyalaze" mu kibiina ekya kkumi na bibiri, omusomesa ayagala abayizi be okusemberera okussaawo amateeka nga bayita mu kwetegereza omukwano wakati w'ebintu ebirambika. Mu mbeera y'etteeka lya Ohm, ku bikolwa bino wammanga kiki ekisaana okukozesebwa ku nsonga eno?
answer_a: Abayizi bakola eggulaafu eraga amaanyi g'amasannyalaze agavaamu (current intensity) okusinzira ku voltisi mu sikito entuufu, nga balowooza nti obuzibu (resistance) bwa nkalakkalira.
answer_b: Abayizi bakola ggulaafu okuva mu mmeeza erimu ebipimo by'amaanyi g'amasannyalaze agayita mu waya ku buli voltisi, oluvannyuma ne baginnyonnyola.
answer_c: Abayizi bakkaanya ku buzibu bw'ebintu ebikulembera amasannyalaze; buli omu aweebwa omuwendo gw'amasannyalaze n'amaanyi g'amasannyalaze nga bipimiddwa mu nkola.
answer_d: Abayizi baweebwa ebipimo by'amasannyalaze ebitali bifaanagana ne bakakasa, nga bayisaawo omugatte gw'amasannyalaze agasaliddwa ku buli kimu, oba ng'ekipimo ky'amasannyalaze ekyatuukirizibwa omukolezi kituufu.

question: Nsomesa yakikula ki esanidde okuwa abayizi okusobola okutandikawo okusobola okutegeera sayansi wa radioactive series?

answer_b: Ensibuko y'obutoffaali bw'ebintu
answer_c: Enkula ya atom okusinzira ku nsengeka ya electrons
answer_d: Obutofaali bw'ebintu ne bunabwo bwebufanagana

question: Kumanya ki okusooka okwetaagisa abayizi okukola ku ndowooza ya VSEPR mu molekyo ez'enjawulo?
answer_a: Omugatte gw'akanyigirizi ka dipole oguvaamu molekyu ez'enjawulo
answer_b: Eteeka lya duet ne octet ku nkola y'obuziba.
answer_c: Okukiikirira empandiika z'ebisengeke bya kemiko ebiri mu molekyuulu
answer_d: Akakodyo ka valence shell electron pair repulsion (VSEPR) nga kakozesebwa ku molekyu ez'enjawulo.

question: Mu kiseera ky’ekibiina ku nkola enkulu eza obutaffaali bw’amasannyalaze ag’ekkemiko mu makolero, pulofeesa ayogera ku butaffaali bw’amasannyalaze ag’ekkemiko obutundibwa obuyitibwa akataffaali ka Downs, akasobozesa okufuna sodiyamu ow’ekyuma nga tuyita mu kuyabuluza omunnyo gwa sodiyamu kkalolayidi (NaCl) oguyengeddwa. Ku bino ebikulu wammanga, kiki ekisobola okulabwa mu kiseera akataffaali ka Downs we kakolera?
answer_a: Sodiyamu ey’ekyuma eterekebwa ku anode olw’okukendeeza kwa ayoni za sodiyamu
answer_b: Ggaasi ya chlorine efulumizibwa ku cathode okuyita mu oxidation ya chloride ions.
answer_c: Ayoni za kkalolayidi zigenda ku anode okwoksidizibwa
answer_d: Obutaffaali bwa sodium butambula okudda ku cathode olw'enkendeeza yaabwo.

question: Omusomesa alimu kukola ebyokuyiga ku nkula y'ensi n'abaana be ab'ekibiina ekyokuna, ayagala okulaga ebika bya obububi ebikola ensi nga akozesa ekintu ekyabulijjo. Bintu ki ku bino wamanga ebisobola okozesebwa okuwa entadikwa ennungi ku kigenda okusomesebwa?
answer_a: Eggi eli kaluba nga fumbe
answer_b: Kadole ka Russia akalimu budole obulala
answer_c: Ebibala ebirimu ebitundu tundu
answer_d: Akapiira ak'ebbombo

question: Omusomesa yateekawo ekibuuzo kino mu kigezo ky'ebikwata ku ntambula y'ebintu: “Omubiri gutambula okusinziira ku kibalangulo kino: x=25+40t−5t2 (nga t ali mu sikonda ate x ali mu mita). Omubiri gunaaba gutambudde mita mmeka nga wayiseewo 5 s ne 6 s?” Bw’amaze okukebera eby’okuddamu, omusomesa akiraba nti abayizi be tebakimanyi nti, okusinziira ku by’okuddamu byabwe, omubiri guba gutambudde obuwanvu butono mu kiseera kiwanvu, kubanga abasinga obungi baddamu nti omubiri gutambudde mita 100 mu sikonda 5 ate mita 85 mu sikonda 6. Ku ngeri eziri wammanga, engeri ki esinga okuba nga yaleetera abayizi abasinga obungi okuzibuwalirwa?
answer_a: Obuzibu obuli mu kusoma ebigambo ebikozesebwa mu bibuuzo bya kinemaatika
answer_b: Obutabaawo kwetendeka mu kumanya ebintu ebirambiddwa n'okukozesa ennyingo ezisaana.
answer_c: Okuteebereza okutali kukkufu ku nsonga ezitali nnamba eziva mu bibuuzo bya kinemattika.
answer_d: Obunafu mu kukulakulanya obukugu mu kubala okusobola okwaŋŋanga okugonjoola ebizibu bya kinemattika

question: Mu ngeri zino wammanga, lwaki olutalo olulaga omulandira ogutandikira ku birowoozo ebya bulijjo okudda ku birowoozo ebikalu ennyo?

Mu mutendera gw'essomo "akaziba n'obuziizi bwako," omusomesa asaba abayizi be ab'omwaka ogw'okuna mu siniya okukola omulimu guno: "Mukubaganye ebirowoozo ku makulu g'okuyiga ku buzziizi bwa akaziba n'engeri gye buyinza okukozesebwa mu tekinologiya, nga mulowooza ku ky'okuba nti, okuva ku ebyo ebibeerawo mu buzziizi bwa atomu obw'ebintu ebimu, kisoboka okufuna amasannyalaze era n'okukulaakulanya tekinologiya asobola okuganyula abantu. Naddala, mukubaganye ebirowoozo ku ky'okuzimba amasannyalaze ga nukiriya mu ggwanga lyaffe okusobola okukola amasannyalaze." Kigendererwa ki eky'okusoma ekisobola okutuukibwako nga omulimu ogusabiddwa gukoleddwa?
answer_a: Nnyonnyola enkula y'akaziba n'obuziizi bwako, ng'otegeera enjawulo wakati w'ebintu eby'enjawulo n'obuziba bwabyo, n'empalirizo ezisookerwako ezizingirwamu, wamu n’amaanyi ag’omusingi agalimu.
answer_b: Yamba abayizi okutegeera obuziba bw'akaziba n'obuziizi bwako, n'okutegeera emirimu gy'abasayansi b'obuziizi
answer_c: Kubiriza abayizi okwagala okukwataganya  n'okusoma kw'obuziba n'enkozesa yabyo mu tekinologiya ne mubulamu obwa bulijjo.
answer_d: Kulaakulanya mu bayizi obusobozi okunnyonnyola engeri amasoboza(amaanyi) gye gafunibwa okuva mu buziizi bwa atomu n'engeri amasoboza(amaanyi) gano gye gayinza okufuulibwamu amasannyalaze.

question: Ku sitaamenti zino wammanga eriwa erina endowooza enkyamu abayizi gye balina ekwata ku kwekolako mu nkola ya sayansi w'amasoboza(thermadynamic processes)?
answer_a: Abayizi balowooza nti okweyongera mu bwetaavu (entropy) kiyamba mu kwetereera.
answer_b: Abayizi bagamba nti ebintu ebitayinza kulemesa nkola za butonde bisobola okuba nga byeyongera okwewooya.
answer_c: Abayizi balowooza nti ebintu ebigenda nga byokka na bwabyo bigenda mangu nnyo.
answer_d: Abayizi balowooza nti ebintu ebyetereera byesigama ku bwoki n’okusaasaanya amasoboza.

question:
Omusomesa ayagala ekibiina kye okumanya etteeka lya Hund erikwata ku bungi obusinga obuyinza okubaawo.
Kati ku mirimu gino wammanga, gumu ku gyo gwe gwandisinze okulaga obanga abayizi batuuse ku kiruubirirwa kino?
answer_a: Okuwandiika endagiriro z'amasannyalaza ag'ensi yonna ez'atomi ez'enjawulo nga ziri mu mbeera ey'ettaka.
answer_b: Okuwandiika empandiika enfunze eyebyamasenyalaze  ez’enjawulo mu atomu nga ziri mu mbeera ey’obutebenkevu.
answer_c: Okugeraageranya okusaasanya kw'obusannyalaza mu bifananyi  ebyekusa okwetoloola akakungulu k'amasannyalaze agali ku ngulu mu atomu ez'enjawulo.
answer_d: Okugerageranya endabika y'kungulu  y’amasannyalaze ag’ebweru aga atomu ez’enjawulo nga ziri mu mbeera eya bulijjo n’eya kusisimuka.

question: Mu kibiina eky'omunaana, mu kitundu ekikwata ku butonde bw'ekintu, omusomesa abasomesa ku butonde bw'akaziba. Okukakasa oba ng'abayizi bategedde enjawulo eri wakati w'omuwendo gw'akaziba n'omuwendo gw'ekintu, abasaba okulaga omuwendo gwa konta, obusannyalazo, n'obutonniinya obuli mu atomu ya aluminiamu, ng'ate aluminiamu alina omuwendo gw'akaziba 13 n'omuwendo gw'ekintu 27. Abayizi abawerako balaga bwe bati: Aluminiamu alina obusannyalazo 27, konta 13, n'obutonniinya 14. Kusoomooza ki abayizi kwe boolekagana nakwo mu kuyiga kwabwe okukwata ku nsonga eno?
answer_a: Okukkiriza nti omuwendo gwa elekitooni gwenkanankana n'omuwendo gwa konta ne nampawengwa.
answer_b: Nga tebategedde nti namba y'akaziba etambulira wamu n'omuwendo gw'amasannyalaze ag'ekika kya pozitiivu
answer_c: Okukkiriza nti namba y'obuzito etegereza omuwendo gwa chaji eri positivu ne negativu
answer_d: Obutamanya nti omuwendo gw'obusannyalazo gwenkanankana n'omuwendo gw'obusannyalazo obw'ekibogwe n'obw'ekisannyalazo.

question:
Omusomesa ategekera ekibiina ky'abayizi abali mu mwaka ogwokusatu mu siniya, ng'ekigendererwa kyabwe kiri "Okutegeera empewozeso eya sentripeta n'amaanyi ga sentripeta ng'ebireetera ekintu okutambula mu ngeri ey'omuzingo ogwa kyenkanyi". Mu kumanya okukulembedde kuno okukwata ku 
buwuka kuki abayizi kwe bateekwa okuba nga bamanyi okusobola okutegeera amaanyi ga sentripeta bwe gakola ku ntambula y'omubiri mu ntambula ey'omuzingo ogwa kyenkanyi?
answer_a: Okuggyako vekita
answer_b: Okugataganya enzala yobuwuka
answer_c: Omugatte gwa 'dot' wakati wobuwuka
answer_d: Okutondeesa obuwuka nga tukozesa ebipimo bya Katisiyaani

question: Biteeso byabayizzi ki wammanga ebi bayamba okuyiga omusingi gwa Archimedes?
answer_a: okulowooza nti puleesa y'omubbanga tekosa puleesa eretebwa amazzi
answer_b: Okulowooza nti obuwanvu bwa mazzi ekintu mwe kigudde buki kaka okunyigibwa amazzi
answer_c: Okulowooza nti puleesa enyiga omubiri ogubbide mu mazzi ku sinziira ku buwanvu bw'ago
answer_d: Okulowooza nti puleesa ya mazzi enyiga wansi wa konteyina nti esinziira ku nkula ya konteyina

question:
Omusomesa omukulu mu ssomero lya siniya ayagala abayizi be okutegeera ebintu ebikulu ebizingirwa mu kuzuula ebbanga ery'ekitundu ery'obulamu bw'ekintu ekifulumya olubugumu.
Kiki omusomesa ky'ayinza okukola okusobozesa abayizi okutuuka ku kiruubirirwa kino?
answer_a: Kuba ekifaananyi ekiraga okuvunda kw'ekintu ekifulumya olubugumu
answer_b: Teekawo ekiteeberezo ku kuvunda kwa nukiriya(obuziizi) okuva mu kintu ekifulumya olubugumu
answer_c: Kozesa obubaka okuva mu kipimo ky’ekiseera n’ekigero ky’obungi bw’ekintu ekifulumizibwa okuva mu kintu ekirina obutaffaali obw’ekika ekimu
answer_d: Koppa(geegenya) okuvunda kw’ekintu ekifulumya olubugumu era olabe omuwendo gw’obutaffaali obuvunda

question:
Omusomesa w’essomero lya siniya mu mwaka ogusooka, mu somo lya Stoichiometry yeetaaga okukebera okutegeera kw’abayizi u kipimo kya Stoichiometry mu mwenkanonkano gwa kemiko ogw'enkanankana..
Ku bikolwa bino wammanga, kiki omusomesa ky’ayinza okuteesa okukakasa okuyiga okwatuukiddwaako?
answer_a: Bala omuwendo gw'ekipimo ky'akazimbulukusa wakati w'ebintu ebikozesebwa n'ebivaamu mu kikolwa.
answer_b: Bala obuzito bw'ebintu ebikozesebwa n'ebivaamu era okakase omukwano(gw'okubala) oguli wakati waabyo mu kubala.
answer_c: Zimba emmeeza (olukalala)  elaga obwenkanankana wakati w'ebintu ebikozesebwa n'ebivaamu, n'omuwendo gwabyo ku buli kikumi.
answer_d: Zimba emmeeza(olukalala) elaga obwenkanankana wakati wa mole, molekyu, n'obuziba, okusinziira ku bintu ebiri mu kikyusabuziba

question: Mu kibiina kya munaana, oluvannyuma lw’okumaliriza okunnyonnyola omulimu gw’ebitundu by’obutoffaali mu butoffaali bwa kika kya eukaryotic, omusomesa agenda kwongera okunnyonnyola omulimu gwabyo ng’akozesa olugero olufaananya ebyuma n’ebitundu by’ekkolero ku butoffaali. answer_a: Masiini ekyusa ebinytu byobulamu okubifuula amaanyi.

question: Mu kwekkeneenya mu bufunze, omusomesa ku mutendera ogw'omunaana ategese okwekeneenya ekigendererwa kino wammanga: "Nnyonyola ebiteeberezebwa ku gisomyo bya Dalton ebikwatagana n'obuziba bw'obuntu." Kwekkeneenya ki okulagiddwa wammanga ogunasobozesa abayizi okutuukiriza ekigendererwa kino?
answer_a: Bikola ebintu eby'ekimiyiki eby'enjawulo okusinziira ku kulonda eby'obuziba bibiri oba okusingawo.
answer_b: Zimuteekawo omuwendo gw’obungi bw’obuziba obwetabye mu kikolwa eky’ekemiko.

answer_d: Bakakasa obuzito bw'ekintu ekiri mu bizimbamubiri bisatu eby'enkalubo y'emu.

question: Omusomesa owa siniya ey'okuna ateekateeka essomo erigendereddwa okuyamba abayizi okutegeera omugaso gw’okugemesa mu by’obulamu bw’abantu bonna. Ku bikolwa bino wammanga ekiyinza okusobozesa omusomesa okutuukiriza ekigendererwa kino okutambulira wamu n’endagaano y’ebiri mu syllabus ekwata ku kumanya okw’ekisaayansi?
answer_a: Ba vunula ebitukuukawo nga okugema kuwedde , okusinzira ku ngezesa enkadde nga eya Edward Jenner
answer_b: Betegeleza, nga basinziira ku chaati, obungi bw’endwadde ezimu ezisiigala era ne bateebereza ebireeta obungi obwo.
answer_c: Bageraageranya, nga basinziira ku chaati, omuwendo gw'abantu abaagemeebwa ne bagukwataganya n'okusaanyizibwawo n'okukomawo  kw'endwadde ezimu.
answer_d: Bazimba olukalala lw'ebikulu ebyatuukiddwaako mu nkola y'okugema, nga balaga omukono gw'abasaayansi abaatandikawo omulimu guno.

question: Mu kibiina kya siniya esooka, abayizi beenyigira mu bikolwa ebikwaata ku ngeri ebifaananyi gye bikolebwamu mu ndabirwamu engolole ne mu ndabirwamu empete. Mu kiseera ky’ekikolwa, omuyizi agolola omukono gwe waggulu n’agamba: "Musomesa, era sitegeera njawulo eri wakati w’ebifaananyi ebituufu n’ebifaananyi ebyaddala n'ebitali byadaala, ne lwaki biyitibwa bwebityo." Kunyonyola ki omusomesa kw’anaakozesa okutangaaza okutabulwatabulwa kw’omuyizi, ng’addamu mu ngeri etegeerekeka era n’obwegendereza obukulu ku kibuzo kye?
answer_a: Laba ku ludda olumu n'olulala olw'ekijiiko. Ekifaananyi ky'olaba nga bw'oli ddala sikituufu ate ekifaananyi ky'olaba nga kikyuse kiba kituufu.
answer_b: Olina okujjikira nti ebifaananyi ebituufu bulijjo biba byesulise okuva waggulu okudda wansi, ate ng’ebifaananyi eby’obulimba bulijjo biba bitereevu.
answer_c: Ebifaananyi ebitali byaddala birabika ng'ebikolebwa emabega w'endabirwamu, ate nga ebifaananyi ebya ddala bikolebwa mu maaso gaayo era bisobola okukubibwa ku lutimbe.
answer_d: Ebifaananyi eby’obulimba bikolebwa mu kifo eky’obulimba ekireetera emiryango gy’omusana okugaziwa, ate ebifaananyi ebya ddala bikolebwa okuyita mu kulagula emiryango gy’omusana egidda waggulu.

question: Omusomesa owa siniya ey'okubiri,mu kitundu kya Kinematics, ajja kukola okwekaliriza okuzuula okutegeera kw'abayizi ku kuva kw'ebintu mu kugwa. Okusinziira ku kigendererwa kino, kiki omusomesa ky'ayinza okukola okuzuula obulungi okumanya kw'abayizi ku nsonga eno?
answer_a: Mu kifo ky'ebweru, basuula ebintu eby'enjawulo waggulu era ne bageraageranya ebipimo bya buli kusuula.
answer_b: Baddamu ebibuuzo ebigendereddwa okugeraageranya n'okusuubira obungi bw'ebiseera ebyetaagisa ebintu eby'enjawulo okugwa okuva waggulu obuwunzifu.
answer_c: Balaga mu kifaananyi obwolekero bw'okwongeza sipiidi y'omupiira gwa ttena nga guli mu bbanga okuva ku muzannyi omu okudda ku mulala.
answer_d: Bakola mmaapu eraga engeri ebintu gye bitambulamu mu bwengula.

question: Omusomesa was siniya ali mu mwaka ogw'okubiri, mu kitundu kya 'sterochemistry' ne 'isomerism' ategekera ekibiina n'ekigenderwa eky'okuyiga wammanga"Okuzuula omugaso gwa R ne S ensengeka y'ekirungo ekigatta ekikozesebwa mu bulamu obwa bulijjo. Ku mirimu egiweereddwa wammanga guliwa ogunakola n'ekigenderwa ekiteeseddwako n'abayizi?
answer_a: Buuza abayizi okufumiitiriza ku makulu g'ebyenfuna agali mu kukola eddagala eririna ebika bya R ne S.
answer_b: Buuza abayizi okunoonyereza ku bintu ebibaawo ku bulamu bw’omuntu ng’akozesa eddagala ebbiri eriri mu ngeri ya enantiomers.
answer_c: Buuza abayizi okugeraageranya obuwangwa bw’ebintu ebirungo obwa R ne S stereoisomer obw’ebintu ebikozesebwa ennyo 5, gamba nga, ibuprofen
answer_d: Baagalire abayizi okukozesa amateeka ga Cahn-Ingold-Prelog okusalawo endagakubbo ya R ne S eya kampawundi 5 ezikozesebwa ennyo, ng'ekyokulabirako, frukitoosi.

question: Mu kibiina kya glued 8, omusomesa akoze ekigezo ku kaziba n’engeri ayoni gye zikolebwamu. Ebivaamu biraga nti omuwendo munene ogw’abayizi balowooza nti okukolebwa kwa keyoni (cations) kuleetebwawo atomu okwongerako oba “okufuna” polotooni (protons). Mulimu ki omusomesa gw’ayinza okuteesa eri abayizi be okubayamba okutegeera obulungi engeri keyoni gye zikolebwamu?
answer_a: Buuza abayizi okutegeera omuwendo gwa pulotoni, erikitulooni, ne nyutulooni eziri mu ayoni ez’enjawulo nga basinziira ku namba y’akaziba (Z) n’ennamba y’obuzito (A).
answer_b: Basabye abayizi okukola, awamu n'omusomesa, emmeza elaga omuwendo gwa pulotoni, erekutulooni, ne nnyutulooni mu katayoni ne anayoni ez'enjawulo.
answer_c: Saba abayizi okukola ekibalanguwa ekiraga engeri emiramwa gino gye gikwatagana: akaziba, olububi, obusannyalaza, obukontanyo,obutaffaali, ayoni, kayoni, n’ayoni enkyamu
answer_d: Bayizi balambike okugeraageranya engeri atomu ya sodium entaanu gy'efaanana n'engeri sodium bw'efaanana ng'ekyebulukusi, nga balowooza ku muwendo gwa purotoni, elekitulooni, ne nyutulooni eza buli emu.

question: Omusomesa, mu mwaka ogusooka ogwa Siniya, mu mutwe gw'eky'obulamu ogw'Enkyukakyuka n'Obungi bw'ebiramu, akola omulimu n'abayizi be mwe balina okugeraageranya amino asidi ez'enjawulo eza puloteni C okuva mu bisolo eby'enjawulo n'okuteebereza enkolagana y'eby'obusika wakati waazo. Mu kiseera ky'okukola omulimu guno, omuyizi abuuza: “Bwe kiba nti ekisukkulumya ebiramu kwe kuba n'amawulire mu DNA yaabyo, mugaso ki ogw'okugeraageranya ennyiriri za amino asidi eza puloteni?”. Nga tutunuulidde omutendera gw'omuyizi, mu nnyonnyola zino omusomesa gy'awa, eyiwa ku kibuzo ky'omuyizi?
answer_a: Ekizimbamubiri kye kimu kisobola okweyoleka mu biramu by’ebika eby’enjawulo. Amawulire agazimba ekizimbamubiri ago galondoolwa mu busirikale bw’obutonde (genes). N’olwekyo, okuyita mu kumanya enjawulo wakati w’obusirikale bw’obutonde obukola ekizimbamubiri n’olukalala lw’ebitundu by’ekizimbamubiri (amino acid sequences), enkolagana z’emyaka gy’obulamu wakati w’ebika bisobola okuteeberezebwa.
answer_b: Protein zikolebwa mu nnyiriri za amino acids ezitegekebwa mu DNA. Bwe wabaawo enkyukakyuka mu kino, kijja kukyusa ennyiriri za amino acids ez'ekirungo ekyo. N'olwekyo, okusinziira ku muwendo gwa amino acids ez'enjawulo ez'ekirungo kye kimu, omuntu asobola okumanya engeri ebika ebibiri gye bikwataganamu mu ngeri y'obuzaale.
answer_c: Puloteni zikolebwa okuva mu kunnyonnyolwa kw’obubaka bwa RNA, obuva mu kuwandiika kwa jjiini. Puloteni eno esobola okulagibwa nga waliwo enkyukakyuka mu nkola y’obusirikale bw’amino asidi. N’olwekyo, nga tukozesa okunoonyereza ku nkola zino, enkolagana z’endabika y’ebiramu ez’enjawulo zisobola okuteekebwawo.
answer_d: Ennyiriri za amino acid ez’ekizimbamubiri zisalibwawo ennyiriri za codons eziba mu mRNA okuva mwe kikolebwa. Okuva buli codon bw’ekwatagana n’ennyiriri za nucleotides essatu, bwe kikyusibwa, ekizimbamubiri ekirimu amino acid ez’enjawulo ku ezo ez’ekizimbamubiri ekisooka kisobola okufunibwa. N’olwekyo, okumanya omuwendo gwa amino acids ez’enjawulo wakati w’ebika ebibiri, omuntu asobola okumanya engeri gye byekuusiza ku kika ekirala mu ngeri y’okukula.

question: Omusomesa wa sekendule,mu kusoma kwomwaaka ogwokubiri, mu kiseera ky’essomo ku DNA oba ndaga butondde  n’okukubisaamu obutaffaali, ateekateeka  omulimu gw’okukolera ku kisomebwaako kino kino: “Okutegeera engeri ebizimba bya kookolo gye bikolebwa”. Magezi ki abayizi ge beetaaga okuba nga bamaze okubimanya okusobola okukola ku kiruubirirwa kino?
answer_a: Ebiseera by'emitendera gw'enkula  yakataffaali
answer_b: Obukulu bw'ekigabanyo ky'obutaffaali ekya mitosisi
answer_c: Ebifo ebikeberwamu ku nkula neneeyisa yobutaffaali
answer_d: Ebika byokwekubisaamu mu DNA oba ndagabutondde ne mu chromosome

question: Omusomesa wa sekondale yetegeka okugenda okusomesa ekibiina ekyo kubiri wana vummurira bino wammamnga:"Okukozesa etteeka ly'obungi bw'amaanyi obutakyuka mu nkola enzigale".Mirimu ki wammanga egiyamba omuyizzi okukola ebiteeseddwa?
answer_a: Bawe ebyokulabirako byo kutomeregana kwo'mutindo ogwamaanyi gye gukuumibwa
answer_b: Ba pima obuzito ne misiinde gye mmotoka nga zitomeregana kuluguudo no'ku kalabulwa
answer_c: Bye bisalawo enkolagana wakati wo'kukaka okuteekebbwawo,obudde bwetekeddwa wo, nentunnunsi omubiri gwe zifuna mu ludda olumu
answer_d: Bisuubira nti alizaati zo kutomeregana wakati wa ma bulooka agafaanagana gaseerera ewatali kwekuutiza

question: Omusomesa omubisi omwaka ogusooka mu Ssekendulewa ateekateeka essomo n’ekigendererwa kino: “Okukozesa omutindo gw’amayengo okunnyonnyola nti ekitangaala kyeyoleka era ne kimenyeka bwe kikuba ekifo ekyawula ebintu bibiri.” Ng’enkola y’okuyigiriza okutuukiriza ekigendererwa kino, omusomesa asalawo okukozesa ebikozesebwa eby’okusomesa ebyanguya okutegeera ebyo ebiri mu somo. Kiki ku bikozesebwa eby’okusomesa wammanga ekikwatagana n’ekigendererwa ky’omusomesa kino?
answer_a: Ekitundu ky’ekitabo ky’essomero ekinnyonnyola enjawulo wakati w’endowooza y’obuntu n’ey’amayengo ku musana, n’obubaka buli emu bwe yawa ku misinde gy’omusana mu kubulukuka.
answer_b: Okutengejja okw’ekikompyuta okulaga mu bujjuvu engeri ebyoya by’omusaayi gw’amazzi gye bikosebwa olw’okukyusa n’okumenyeka kw’ekitangaala nga kikuba ekifo wakati w’ebintu bibiri
answer_c: Okulaga mu kibiina omutangaavu gwa leza nga gukuba amazzi agali mu akuliyamu, we kiyinza okulabirwa nti ekitundu ku mutangaavu guddamu waggulu ate ekitundu ekirala ne kimenyeka ku mpalazo engeri engeri.
answer_d: Omulimu ogukolebwa ku kompyuta ogusobozesa omuyizi okulaba nga omutangaavu bwe gutumizibwa ku kintu ekigabanya ebintu bibiri eby’enjawulo, ekitundu kimu kiguddamu ate ekitundu ekirala ne kiyitamu nga buli kimu kirina engeli yakyo.

question: Ekimu ku bigendererwa abayizi abali mu mwaka ogw'okubiri mu siniya bye bakolerako kwe "kutegeka n'okunnyonnyola obubaka(data) obukwata ku ngeri ebintu ebitali bya bulijjo gye bikolamu."Ku mirimu gino wammanga, gwe guleka omuntu okukebereza ekigendererwa ekyo waggulu?
answer_a: Wa abayizi obubaka(data) obukwata ku amafuta kwe gatandikira okwesera era obabuuze okwekenneenya oba gaba gakwafu, gakulukusi oba ga ggaasi ku tempulikya y'ekisenge.
answer_b: Saba abayizi okunoonyereza ku bubonero bw’okubulukuka kw’ebinywamaji bya kaboni eby’obuwanvu obwenjawulo, babitegeke mu mmeeza, era balambulule oba biri mu mbeera ya kikalu, kikulukusi, oba ggaasi ku tempulikya eya bulijjo.
answer_c: Wa abayizi data ku tempulikya ebyokirokaboni ze zibulira ku buwanvu bw'enziringanya ez'enjawulo ezitegekeddwa mu tebuleni era obasabe okunnyonnyola empisa okusinziira ku mikwanaganyo egireeteddwa molekyuulu.
answer_d: Wa abayizi data ku tempulikya ebyokola bwa haidrokaboni ez’obuwanvu bw’enziring’anya obw’enjawulo, ze balina okutegeka mu tebuleni okusinziira ku muwendo gwa kaboni mu nziring’anya oluvannyuma bannyonnyole engeri eno gy’ekolamu okusinziira ku bunene bw’enkolagana molekyu ze ziraga.
